Data Deletion

Last updated: 20 October 2026

How to delete the data KenganSocial holds about you, including data from Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, and what happens when you do.

Delete your whole account

  • Sign in and open Dashboard › Settings › Privacy & data.
  • Optional: choose Download my data to keep a copy.
  • Choose Delete account, type DELETE and confirm.

We immediately revoke every connected social account at its platform, then delete your workspaces, posts, media files, analytics, messages, leads and your sign-in. You receive a confirmation code you can look up below. Backups are cleared within 30 days.

Delete the data from one platform

Open Dashboard › Connections and choose Disconnect on the account. We revoke our access at the platform, delete the access tokens straight away, and delete the data that connection brought in within 7 days.

  • Facebook or Instagram: you can also remove KenganSocial in Facebook under Settings & privacy › Settings › Business integrations. Meta notifies us and we delete your Facebook and Instagram data automatically.
  • YouTube: you can also revoke access in your Google account’s security settings. We then delete your YouTube data within 30 days.
  • TikTok: you can also remove KenganSocial in the TikTok app under Settings and privacy › Security › Manage app permissions.

Ask us by email

Email privacy@kengansocial.com from the address on your account with the subject "Delete my data". We confirm and complete the deletion within 30 days, and tell you if the law requires us to keep anything (for example tax records) and why.

Check a deletion request

Open www.kengansocial.com/data-deletion/status and enter your confirmation code.
